transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... I suppose it's just that I can't seem to sit down much. For the last year or so, anyway. 

I'm always... puttering. Fixing things around the house, arranging this or that, or volunteering for one more thing. You'd think at 87 I would just rest, but... I just have a hard time being still. That's really it.
Do you feel like you're doing all these activities because you're trying to calm down or relax, or is it just that you don't feel like sitting still?
I'm not really sure. I haven't thought about it quite like that. I suppose I just... don't sit. I don't know that it's about calming down, it's just how I am.
Do you feel like your constant activity is causing problems for you or those around you?

I suppose... maybe a little. I don't mean to, but... well, at the senior center, I’ve had to apologize to folks after our meetings a few times. And... one of my friends recently suggested I might want to take a smaller role at the sign-up table. She said my manner was... making things a bit tense. So, I guess it does affect others sometimes.
Do you feel like your constant activity is causing you a lot of stress or anxiety?
No... I wouldn't say that. I don't really feel anxious. I'm just... busy, I suppose. It doesn't really bother me that way.
Do you often act on impulse without thinking things through?
I don't... I don't believe so. No. I usually know what I'm doing. I wouldn't really say I'm impulsive.
Has being overly active and having trouble sitting still been a part of your personality for most of your life?

I suppose it has. Yes. Even back... well, back in grade school, I remember getting scolded sometimes. Just for popping out of my seat, or... talking over my classmates. The teachers said I was just too lively. That was long before I was even a teenager. So... yes. Always been this way, I guess.
Are you having trouble completing tasks or projects because you can't focus on one thing for too long?
No... I don't think so. I usually finish whatever I start. My focus seems fine, really.
Do you feel like your constant activity and trouble sitting still causes you any personal distress?
Distress? No... I wouldn't use that word. It's just the way I am. I don't think it really bothers me.
Have you noticed any decline in your cognitive abilities, such as memory or thinking, over the past few years?
No... I don't believe so. My memory seems fine. I haven't really noticed anything like that.
Have you experienced any significant changes in your mood over the past year?
Mood? No... not really. I feel about the same as I always do, I suppose. Nothing I'd call a significant change.
Did you have any symptoms of inattention, such as difficulty paying attention to details or making careless mistakes, when you were younger?
When I was younger? No... I don't really recall having trouble with that. I managed just fine, as far as I remember.
Have you noticed any problems with your balance or walking over the past year?
No... I get around well enough, I suppose. I haven't really had any trouble with my balance.
Have you experienced any significant decline in your ability to perform daily activities on your own over the past year?
No... I still manage on my own. I haven't noticed any real difference in what I can do. I just go about my day same as usual.
Have you had any trouble learning new things recently?
No... I don't think so. I haven't really had to learn anything new lately, to be honest. So... no, no trouble.
Do you think your memory is as good as it was 10 years ago?
I suppose so. I don't... I don't really spend time comparing it to back then. It seems fine enough to me. I remember what I need to, anyway.
Were you considered hyperactive as a child?

Yes... I suppose so. I remember getting scolded in grade school. The teachers told me I was too lively... long before I was even a teenager. I just... I guess I had a habit of popping out of my seat. And talking over my classmates. But... yes, that's all.
Did you ever receive a diagnosis of ADHD or attention deficit disorder when you were younger?
No... I don't believe so. They didn't really give out names for that sort of thing when I was a girl. So... no.
Have you noticed any decline in your ability to understand or follow conversations?
No... I don't think so. I seem to follow along just fine. As long as people speak clearly... no, I haven't noticed any trouble.
Do you think your inability to sit still and constant activity have caused you any problems in your relationships or work life over the years?

I... suppose there have been a few moments. Just minor things. At the senior center... I've had to apologize after some of our meetings. And, well... one friend suggested I take a smaller role at the sign-up table. She said my manner was making things a bit tense. So... yes. I suppose it has.
Have you experienced any significant decline in your cognitive abilities, such as memory, language, or problem-solving, that is not explained by normal aging?
No... nothing like that. My memory is... fine, I think. Just the usual things you'd expect at my age. So... no. I haven't noticed anything unusual.
